name: Catfolk Slayer
body:
Prerequisite(s): Catfolk, varies (see below)

Benefit: A catfolk slayer can select deadly scratch, graceful faller, nimble climber, or vicious claws in place of a slayer talent. Any talent effects based on rogue level use the slayer’s class level. The slayer must fulfill any prerequisites as normal. This talent can be selected multiple times; each time, it grants a new catfolk rogue talent.
